limitations: Only the genus-three one-point class over F_9 is treated. No isomorphism of principally polarized Jacobians or integral endomorphism ring is claimed; no independent external validation is claimed.
scientific_integrity: The model and its single rational point appeared in a 2024 preprint; the 2026 work establishes the canonical one-point isomorphism class. The new computation is the full zeta polynomial, extension-field counts, and rational Jacobian group, with exact independently oriented enumeration loops and an algebraic Frobenius argument. The complete text of a related 2026 conference classification chapter was not accessible, so a residual originality risk remains.
title: The full Frobenius polynomial and rational Jacobian group of the one-point Hermitian-relative quartic
